glosses: to embellish, to decorate, to make more stylish

forms.form:
te zullen opleuken
op te zullen leuken

examples.text: Ik citeer hier de Lonely Planet en hoewel het proza van deze reisgids in staat zou zijn om zelfs de Gazastrook nog op te leuken (‘the locals are very passionate’) moet gezegd worden: die Malediven zien er verdomd mooi uit.
Je moet je cv toch iets opleuken.

glosses: To get dressed up in showy clothing or jewellery.

examples.text: I need to pimp up a little before going out.

glosses: To decorate or prettify in a showy manner.
To make pretty or prettier, to make more attractive, especially only in a superficial way.

examples.text: Old-fashioned bosses see their role as prettifying the office and forming a pool of potential marriage partners for male employees.
